description.fun: Bounsweet is a little mangosteen that smells so delicious Alolans keep it as a living air freshener, since its scent calms people down. That sweetness has a downside: Toucannon and Greedent like to swallow it whole. When it flees, it skips along so cheerfully that nobody realises it's in trouble, so no one ever comes to help.
description.guide: Bounsweet is a Grass-type Pokémon from Alola based on the mangosteen fruit. Its sweet, calming scent makes it popular with people, but also with predators. It evolves into Steenee at level 18.
description.tagline: A sweet-smelling fruit that skips merrily away from danger

description.fun: Steenee is a tomboyish mangosteen that bounces around the forest with its hardened calyx leaves spinning, smacking anything nearby without a care. In a fight, foes get hit by the leaves first and then a kick from its equally hard legs. Its scent is a popular antiperspirant that leaves people refreshed, and its peeled rind is used for stomach aches.
description.guide: Steenee is a Grass-type Pokémon that evolves from Bounsweet, resembling a mangosteen and a young girl. It attacks with its spinning calyx and strong kicks, and people use its fragrance. It evolves into Tsareena when levelled up knowing Stomp.
description.tagline: A tomboyish fruit that kicks and twirls through the forest

description.fun: Tsareena is a mangosteen queen, fitting for a fruit nicknamed the 'Queen of Fruit', with a crown on its calyx and legs like long boots. It kicks with graceful precision and cackles every time it lands a hit, and it will even punish its own Trainer for a command it dislikes. Touching its crown calms it instantly, and since only the strongest Steenee evolve, it uses its power to protect them.
description.guide: Tsareena is a Grass-type Pokémon and the final form of Bounsweet, and it is female-only. It evolves from Steenee when levelled up knowing Stomp, and fights with powerful kicks, including its signature Trop Kick. It is proud and aggressive but protects its pre-evolutions.
description.tagline: A haughty fruit queen with killer kicks and a crown
